01 / The mandate

A financial foundation built to outlast any single campaign.

The fund brings donor generosity, professional investment management and documented board oversight into one enduring structure.

Contributions are recorded, acknowledged and stewarded as long-term capital. The corpus is protected and invested under an approved policy; only authorised distributions support the Medical Centre.

This turns isolated gifts into a dependable institutional resource—one that can strengthen care while maintaining clear accountability to donors, trustees and the communities IBMC serves.

02 / The capital model

Every contribution moves through a controlled chain of stewardship.

  1. 01

    Receive

    Accept cash, assets, securities and contributed expertise through documented channels.

  2. 02

    Verify

    Confirm donor intent, contribution value, restrictions and supporting records.

  3. 03

    Invest

    Manage the corpus in line with the approved Investment Policy Statement.

  4. 04

    Distribute

    Release only board-approved support, with the decision and use recorded.

  5. 05

    Report

    Reconcile gifts, investments, distributions and outcomes in a consistent reporting cycle.

∞

The governing principle

Protect the corpus. Deploy returns with discipline.

The endowment is not a general operating account. It is a ring-fenced pool of capital with its own policy, approvals, records and performance reporting.

03 / Ways to contribute

Capital is more than cash.

The fund is structured to recognise financial gifts, productive assets and professional capacity.

A

Cash gifts

One-time or scheduled pledges in NGN or USD, subject to approved payment and banking channels.

Prepare a cash pledge →
B

Equipment & property

Clinical equipment, land or other property, assessed and accepted through a documented review.

C

Shares & securities

Transferable financial assets, subject to valuation, legal review and the fund’s acceptance policy.

D

Professional service

Specialist expertise or volunteer time recorded as a formal commitment to the Medical Centre.

04 / Governance

Clear authority. Independent expertise. Traceable decisions.

The operating model separates oversight, investment advice, donor stewardship and day-to-day administration.

Oversight

IBMC Board

Approves policy, appointments and distributions; receives consolidated fund reporting.

Direction

Endowment Fund Committee

Coordinates governance, reviews performance and makes recommendations to the Board.

Capital

Investment Subcommittee

Oversees mandate, managers, risk, asset allocation and policy compliance.

Relationships

Donor Relations Subcommittee

Guides donor communication, acknowledgement and responsible recognition.

Professional assurance

Investment, legal and audit advisers

Provide specialist input within clearly defined mandates and reporting lines.
